# TPC-Havoc Q6_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(l2.l_extendedprice * l2.l_discount)
    FROM lineitem AS l2
    WHERE
      l2.l_shipdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND l2.l_shipdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
      AND l2.l_discount BETWEEN 0.06 - 0.01 AND 0.06 + 0.01
      AND l2.l_quantity < 24
  ) AS revenue
```
